findings.summary: If the task file moves to backlog/completed/ in the PR branch (as this very PR does), then in the review phase task.filePath may point at the completed/ path. That path is absent from origin/main, so review routing falls back to 'uncategorized' while developer routing used the real class. The fallback is safe and logged, but the cell can differ between the dev and review phases. Consider a fallback that also looks for the same basename under backlog/tasks/ on the base ref, or confirm that filePath is not updated before review.

findings.summary: taskClassFromBaseRef looks up the task file at its current worktree path on origin/main. The normal completion step (this PR included) moves the file from backlog/tasks/ to backlog/completed/. After that move the path does not exist on origin/main, so review rounds and Step 7 resolve to 'uncategorized'. A developer can also force this fallback on purpose by moving or renaming its own task file. This does nothing today: every cell in .ai-sdlc/model-routing.yaml is wildcard-only, so 'uncategorized' gets the same model as any other class. It becomes a downgrade path once a class-specific cell or override is added. Suggestion: look the file up on the base ref by task ID, searching backlog/tasks/ and backlog/completed/ at origin/main.
